learning_outcomes.text: Acquire knowledge and understanding of human anatomy to comprehend biomedical and biomechanical aspects of the human body, necessary for analyzing physiological and mechanical processes.

Possess sufficient basic knowledge of human anatomy to recognize, name, locate, and orient anatomical elements, providing insight into the physiology and potential disturbances of physiological systems and organs.
Command sufficient knowledge of accurate anatomical terminology and understand the composition and coherence of various anatomical organs within the human body's anatomical systems.

syllabus_topics: Description of different systems, their organs, structure, and cell composition
Introduction to Histology: tissues of the musculoskeletal system
Bone tissue, bone types, and bone formation
Damage and repair of nerve tissue
Introduction to anatomical systems of the human body
assessment_rules: The assessment is a written exam during the examination period, consisting of open questions. The modality for the second examination opportunity is the same as for the first.
